title_en: Pope bids 'hasta luego' to his second homeland of Peru as he wraps up marathon South American trip
title_zh: 教皇结束了他的南美马拉松之旅，向他的第二故乡秘鲁告别

paragraphs.en: LIMA, Peru -- LIMA, Peru (AP) — Pope Leo XIV bid farewell to his beloved second homeland of Peru on Monday with an “hasta luego,” after a marathon 12-day South American tour that tested his stamina after lung cancer surgery.
paragraphs.zh: 秘鲁利马（美联社）——教皇利奥十四世周一以一句“回头见”（hasta luego）向他深爱的第二故乡秘鲁告别。此前，他结束了为期12天的南美马拉松式访问，此行在肺癌手术后考验了他的体力。

paragraphs.en: During the traditional popemobile ride before Leo's final Mass, someone threw an apparent rosary toward the pope that seemed to hit him in the face. The pope winced and touched his temple, but he proceeded on and the Mass began as planned. The Vatican said some 1.5 million people attended.
paragraphs.zh: 在利奥主持最后一场弥撒前的传统教皇专车巡游中，有人朝教皇扔出一串显然是念珠的东西，似乎击中了他的脸。教皇皱了皱眉，摸了摸太阳穴，但仍继续前行，弥撒按计划开始。梵蒂冈称约有150万人参加了这场弥撒。

paragraphs.en: The faithful often toss rosaries, stuffed animals, sports jerseys and other items towards the popemobile and Leo has often wowed the crowd with his quick reflexes in catching them. His bodyguards, though, have lamented that such tossed objects are among their chief concerns in protecting the pope when he is out in public.
paragraphs.zh: 信众常常朝教皇专车投掷念珠、毛绒玩具、球衣和其他物品，利奥也常以敏捷的反应接住这些物品，令人群惊叹。不过，他的保镖们抱怨说，在保护教皇公开露面时，这类投掷物是他们最担心的问题之一。

paragraphs.en: For the Chicago-born Leo, who spent two decades in Peru as a missionary priest and bishop, the trip was an emotional homecoming to a place that he has credited with teaching him how to be a shepherd. Upon arrival, he declared that Peru was his “patria” or homeland, and he sang the national anthem alongside President Keiko Fujimori. Leo has American and Peruvian citizenship.
paragraphs.zh: 对出生于芝加哥的利奥来说——他曾在秘鲁作为传教士神父和主教度过二十年——此行是一次情感上的回乡之旅，回到一个他归功于教会他如何做牧者的地方。抵达时，他宣布秘鲁是他的“祖国”（patria），并与总统藤森庆子（Keiko Fujimori）一同唱了国歌。利奥拥有美国和秘鲁双重国籍。

paragraphs.en: Over the course of the trip, it became clear that Leo modeled his ministry in Peru and now for the universal Catholic Church on the figure of the first archbishop of Lima, St. Turibius of Mogrovejo.
paragraphs.zh: 在此行过程中，人们清楚地看到，利奥在秘鲁乃至如今为普世天主教会开展的事工，都以利马首任大主教圣图里比奥·德莫格罗韦霍（St. Turibius of Mogrovejo）为榜样。

paragraphs.en: “I have felt at home, and you have reminded me that the Church truly is a family. It was here that you taught me how to be a bishop, and this time I learned a little more about serving as the Successor of Peter,” he said at the end of Mass.
paragraphs.zh: “我感到宾至如归，你们让我想起教会确实是一个家庭。正是在这里，你们教会了我如何做主教，而这一次，我对作为彼得继承者的服务有了更多了解，”他在弥撒结束时说。

paragraphs.en: Mogrovejo, who lived from 1538-1606, is revered for having denounced abuses against Indigenous and enslaved people by Spanish colonizers. He is also remembered for having crisscrossed his vast diocese on foot and horseback to minister to his flock, learning Quechua and Aymara to better preach to its Indigenous members and overseeing the translation of church teachings so they could understand.
paragraphs.zh: 莫格罗韦霍生于1538年，卒于1606年，因谴责西班牙殖民者对原住民和奴役对象的虐待而受人敬仰。人们还记得他徒步和骑马走遍广阔的教区，牧养他的羊群，学习克丘亚语和艾马拉语以便更好地向原住民成员布道，并监督教会教义的翻译，使他们能够理解。

paragraphs.en: Following his example, Leo traveled across Peru to where the Catholic hierarchy rarely goes to minister to his flock, going high up in the Andes mountains and deep into the Amazon rainforest and points in between. On his final full day in Peru on Sunday, Leo went from his former diocese of Chiclayo on the north Pacific coast to the southeastern Andean city of Cusco, to the northeastern Amazonian city of Pucallpa and back to Lima on the coast.
paragraphs.zh: 利奥效法他的榜样，走遍秘鲁，前往天主教高层很少涉足的地方牧养羊群，深入安第斯高山、亚马孙雨林以及其间各地。周日在秘鲁的最后一个完整日子，利奥从他曾任职的北太平洋沿岸奇克拉约教区，前往东南部安第斯城市库斯科，再到东北部亚马孙城市普卡尔帕，最后返回沿海的利马。

paragraphs.en: The climatic and altitude changes alone were exhausting — from hot, humid Chiclayo to chilly and rainy Cusco (at an oxygen-challenging altitude of 3,400 meters or about 11,150 feet) to the steaming heat of the Pucallpa rainforest and back to the gray humidity of Lima.
paragraphs.zh: 仅气候和海拔的变化就足以令人疲惫——从炎热潮湿的奇克拉约，到寒冷多雨、海拔3400米（约11150英尺）令人缺氧的库斯科，再到普卡尔帕雨林的蒸腾暑热，最后回到利马灰蒙蒙的潮湿之中。

paragraphs.en: It was a daylong lesson in what it means to be a shepherd. But it also served to say “So there!” to the nay-sayers, including some in the Vatican who had questioned whether Leo would have to change the course of his pontificate given his lung cancer diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 这是长达一天的课程，教人明白做牧者意味着什么。但它也等于对唱衰者说“就是这样！”，其中包括梵蒂冈一些曾质疑利奥在确诊肺癌后是否不得不改变其教皇任期方向的人。
